name: Nellie Pou
subject: Families across the state are feeling it
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/115406/images/pout-header-3.png]

Friend,

Families across New Jersey are feeling it: gas, groceries, and rent all cost more, but wages haven't kept up. The pressure that working people are under right now is real, and it is not going away on its own.

Summer is supposed to be a time when families get a little breathing room. Instead, people are making difficult decisions and canceling their vacations to cut costs, but this administration doesn't seem to care.

They signed a big, ugly budget that handed tax breaks to billionaires and let tariffs drive up the cost of everything from groceries to gas. Every time working families need Washington to show up, this administration finds a reason to look the other way.

I got into politics because I believe the government is supposed to help people, not hurt them, ignore them, or make their lives harder to score political points.

The general election is coming, and this district is going to be fought over hard. The special interests and dark money groups have already started spending against us, so we need to be ready for anything that comes our way.

Will you chip in just $1 today to help me keep fighting for the families who can't afford for us to lose? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pou_em?refcode=260708_np_costs_l1&amount=1]

CHIP IN $1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pou_em?refcode=260708_np_costs&amount=1]

Thank you,

Nellie

The
Supreme Court doesn’t even bother hiding its corruption anymore, and the
recent rulings show it.

Gut the Voting Rights Act based on incorrect data? Sure.
Rule in favor of billionaires? Just about every time.
Compassion for criminal defendants? That’s too much.

This is a wishlist for the powerful and wealthy. And the Supreme Court is
making it happen one decision at a time.

It’s so blatant now that even the most cautious, “let’s not rock the boat”
Senate Democrats are fed up.

Demand Justice President Josh Orton put it bluntly: "The current Roberts
majority has been so condescending and intellectually dishonest that even
mainstream, normie Democratic senators are just fundamentally insulted —
because they're lying to their faces in these decisions."

Lying to their faces. Let that sink in.

This Court isn’t beholden to the Constitution. It’s beholden to Trump, to
the corporations bankrolling his allies, and to the billionaires who’ve
spent decades buying exactly this outcome.

Demand Justice was built to fight for an independent Court that answers to
the American people — not the highest bidder. That means structural reform
like expanding the bench. It means holding every justice accountable for
who they’re actually ruling for.

But taking on the highest court in the nation takes a lot of resources and
sustained public pressure.

It’s beholden to Trump, to the corporations bankrolling his allies, and to the billionaires who’ve spent decades buying exactly this outcome. A Fox News poll shows me ahead in Ohio’s Senate race.
Peter –

**The momentum behind our campaign is growing, but so is the target on our backs. Republicans can see we’re putting up a fight, and they’re going to do whatever it takes to stop us in our tracks.****[Before I say more, can you split any amount between my campaign and Small Town PAC so we can hit our $100K rapid response goal and take on whatever’s next?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260708-partner-sb.vci7rj&amount=5&refcode=em20260708-843&t=3&akid=843%2E34582%2ELOov4g)**

Before it hosted the Grand Ole Opry or the biggest country music acts in America, the Ryman was built as a church, inspired by the revivals of evangelist Sam Jones. Before it hosted the Grand Ole Opry or the biggest country music acts in America, the Ryman was built as a church, inspired by the revivals of evangelist Sam Jones. And we felt God calling us to bring the sound of revival back to that hallowed hall. It's been decades since the Ryman has hosted a free worship concert, but that's exactly what we're going to do. But we can't do it alone. Watch the update below. And for those who can't join us in person, we just put down a deposit on equipment to livestream this night across the world! **Democrats call that unfair. We call it Florida.**

They didn't come to Florida to bring their politics with them. But the Democrats funding this takeover — the national donors, the liberal super PACs, the out-of-state operatives — they absolutely did.

And if we don't stop them, the Sunshine State gets a very different forecast.

Higher taxes. More government. Less freedom. And a whole lot of Socialist storm clouds where the sunshine used to be. ☀️

Patriot, you don't have to live in Florida to care about what happens here. What happens in Florida shapes the entire national map. Will you stand with us today?

Free. And then Democrats got hold of it. Now it's a cautionary tale — sky-high taxes, crumbling cities, a mass exodus of families and businesses fleeing for greener pastures. Most of them? They moved to Florida. And now the Left wants to follow them here. The radical Left has made Florida their number one midterm target. They are spending millions to flip the Governor's mansion, the Senate seat, and races up and down the ballot — all because they know what taking Florida would mean. It's not just a state to them. Florida is President Trump's home state. It's the largest Republican stronghold in the country. It's the place that has proven, over and over again, that conservative governance works — that you can have low taxes, safe streets, great schools, and a booming economy all at the same time. Democrats call that unfair. We call it Florida. They didn't come to Florida to bring their politics with them. But the Democrats funding this takeover — the national donors, the liberal super PACs, the out-of-state operatives — they absolutely did. And if we don't stop them, the Sunshine State gets a very different forecast. Higher taxes. More government. Less freedom. body:
Children’s Hospital Colorado insurance data tells one story—its testimony another.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey friends,
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Also, stay tuned for today's deep-dive video on Children's Hospital Colorado insurance data surrounding gender treatments.
Here's a summary of today's top stories:
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** [Victor Marx holds a narrow lead](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over Kirkmeyer in the GOP governor primary. AG Weiser joined 24 states suing over a USPS mail-ballot proposal. Families protest [new Medicaid caregiver-hour caps](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for disabled kids. Pickens Technical College repeatedly [denied a disabled student's accommodations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) despite a federal settlement, then dismissed her. Children's Hospital Colorado stipulated in court filings that [up to 806 minors received puberty blockers or hormones in a single year](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — more than 35 times what a Do No Harm insurance analysis had shown. The hospital has since been subpoenaed by the DOJ.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** [Hearings began in Tyler Robinson's trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for Charlie Kirk's assassination, with most evidence admitted over defense objections. "Trump Accounts" launched, drawing [6 million+ sign-ups for $1,000-seeded newborn savings accounts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) under the One Big Beautiful Bill.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** O'Donnell's Part 3 flags [30,306 Colorado ballots mailed out of state and 21,259 abroad](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), including unverified addresses in Russia, Iran, and North Korea. Minary critiques [socialism's real-world record via Mamdani and Kiros](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), arguing capitalism under the Constitution is "the BEST worst form of government ever created."
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, July 8, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Children’s Hospital Colorado insurance data tells one story—its testimony another.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KELLY NOTARFRANCESCO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Hundreds of children were provided puberty blockers or cross-sex hormones by Children’s Hospital Colorado’s TRUE Center for Gender Diversity annually in 2024 and 2025 — in numbers that may be more than 35 times higher than those previously reported in 2024 by medical watchdog group Do No Harm.
Do No Harm (DNH) analyzed five years of insurance data and demonstrated an average of 22 minor patients per year had received either puberty blockers or hormone therapy at Children’s from 2019-2023. DNH’s analysis led it to place Children’s on its “Dirty Dozen” list of the 12 worst-offending children’s hospitals promoting sex change treatments for minors.
The stark difference between Children’s self-reported numbers of medicalized minors and DNH’s insurance data numbers raises questions at a time when hospitals and the medical community are under increased scrutiny from the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services and the Department of Justice for potential health care fraud.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Pickens Technical College signed a disability agreement. Then dismissed the student.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_A decade-long EMT who needed only occasional video attendance was stonewalled, dismissed on fabricated dates, and abandoned by the federal office that had secured her a legally binding resolution agreement._
* Pickens Technical College signed a federal resolution agreement committing to re-enroll the student and process her accommodations properly — then immediately resumed denying her video attendance and dismissed her citing absences on dates that fell before the semester had even started.
* The college had previously granted a pregnant student the exact same video accommodation it claimed was impossible due to accreditation — a double standard OCR's own investigation confirmed, yet Pickens continued resisting the agreement it had signed.
* With OCR having gutted its staff, closed seven of twelve regional offices, and dropping disability resolution agreements from 390 in 2024 to just 83 in 2025, CSW had no practical recourse — she has since abandoned her respiratory therapy dream and received a diagnosis of brain lesions potentially indicating MS.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado’s dirty voter roll: Where the ballots go](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MIKE O'DONNELL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_A data review of Colorado's public voter roll finds ballots flowing to 30,306 out-of-state and 21,259 international addresses — including war zones and sanctioned nations — while the Secretary of State requires no verification whatsoever._
* Colorado is mailing ballots to 30,306 out-of-state addresses, and a spot-check found 27% of registrants receiving ballots in Alabama were also registered there — with one registrant appearing to have voted in both states in November 2024, a federal crime the author reported to the Colorado AG and DOJ.
* Any registrant can add an international mailing address and immediately gain e-voting access under UOCAVA — a loophole documented by registrants listing addresses in North Korea, an abandoned U.S. embassy in Sudan, Iran, Syria, Afghanistan, and Russia, with zero verification required by the Secretary of State.
* Colorado pays $50,000 a year to ERIC to manage voter roll data that the author argues could be handled directly for $60 a month — and 53% of active registrants exploiting the international address loophole are registered Democrats.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****[Why capitalism and the Constitution still offer America’s best path](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY RUSS MINARY | COMMENTARY | JULY 7** _“From each according to his abilities, to each according to his needs.” – Karl Marx. Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels published “The Communist Manifesto” in 1848. The popular quote above appeared in Marx’s “Critique of the Gotha Programme” written 1875._ __
**[No way out: Rural Colorado is outvoted at every turn](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY GABE EVANS | COMMENTARY | JULY 3**
_Tom Harrington manages a 500-cow operation on the Crystal River Ranch, two miles from the town of Carbondale on a mesa west of town. He grew up in Ridgway._ ____
__**[The bonds that cannot be dissolved](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | COMMENTARY | JULY 5** _The Declaration of Independence opens by taking something apart. Before it reaches life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness, it lays out why one people must “dissolve the political bands” that tie them to another. The founding act is a break._**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__

**Feel like you have a unique story, commentary or tip to share?** Email [submit@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:submit@rockymountainvoice.com).

Hey Peter,
Senate Republicans failed _again_ to pass a budget on time, for the fifth year in a row, and working families are paying the price right now.
Costs for housing, utilities, and groceries are soaring while federal cuts have already stripped hundreds of thousands of Pennsylvanians of health coverage and food assistance. An estimated 160,000 people dropped Pennie coverage because costs rose, and 236,000 people lost SNAP benefits. **People are being squeezed from every direction, and our state leaders need to act.**
There is a clear, practical plan on the table. In June, the Tax Billionaires, Fund PA campaign passed a bipartisan digital ad tax through the House.
The Digital Ad Tax would expand Pennsylvania’s existing five percent Gross Receipts Tax to include digital advertising platforms like Google, Meta, and Amazon, **bringing roughly $500 million in new, recurring revenue to the commonwealth.** This is money on the table that could prevent deeper cuts to healthcare, food assistance, and other basics families rely on.

clean_body: Friends, I went on 77 WABC to talk about the Fourth of July, and there was one moment I could not stop thinking about. | Friends, to talk about the Fourth of July, and there was one moment I could not stop thinking about. On the eve of the Fourth, Zohran Mamdani sat at the desk of George Washington and used it to attack this country, demean our history, and push his socialist vision. As the daughter of immigrants, a Cuban father and a Greek mother, I know what this country gave my family. I know how rare it is. | Mamdani came here as an immigrant from Uganda and rose to become mayor of the largest city in America. Where else in the world does that happen? That is what makes this country exceptional. It does not matter where you came from or how you started. You can still achieve greatness here. He should have gotten up there and simply said thank you. Instead, he chose to point out everything he finds wrong with America. That was a missed opportunity, and frankly, it was shameful. Our great city deserves leaders who love this country, not ones who root against it. I am the ONLY Republican member of Congress from New York City, and I am not going to stay quiet while our city is run down. | If you believe America is worth defending, and worth being grateful for, I am asking you to stand with me. | | | | | Your support keeps me in this fight. Thank you, Nicole | Nicole for New York, PO Box 60487, Staten Island, NY 10306

name: DNC HQ
subject: what’s your plan to vote?
body:
---
We have a question for you, Derek: Do you have a plan to vote? **Election Day is approaching fast, and here at the DNC, we’re doing everything we can to help Democrats win in November.** We’re registering thousands of young people in key states, providing support to state parties, and supporting more than 10,000 Democratic campaigns across the country. Over the next four months, our team will work day in and day out to push Democrats everywhere over the finish line. **But all of that hard work will be for nothing if you don’t vote. Can you please use[**this link](https://ak.democrats.org/go/63758?t=1&akid=7969%2E22930333%2EGAYg8C)** to confirm your voter registration is up to date?** [**If your registration is up to date, will you please confirm that you have a plan to vote?**](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/20260708_Voting_Plan_Survey/?refcode=em_20260708_7969_fr&amount=7&akid=7969%2E22930333%2EGAYg8C) **[Yes, I’m voting by mail!](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/20260708_Voting_Plan_Survey/?refcode=em_20260708_7969_fr&akid=7969%2E22930333%2EGAYg8C)** **[Yes, I’m voting early in-person!](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/20260708_Voting_Plan_Survey/?refcode=em_20260708_7969_fr&akid=7969%2E22930333%2EGAYg8C)** **[Yes, I’m voting on Election Day in-person!](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/20260708_Voting_Plan_Survey/?refcode=em_20260708_7969_fr&akid=7969%2E22930333%2EGAYg8C)** Thank you for being a partner in this fight. We’re so grateful for your support. The Democrats

clean_body: | | Dear Friend, Every conversation matters. As we continue building momentum across Pennsylvania's 14th Congressional District, one of the most effective ways you can help elect Alan Bradstock is by talking with voters in your community. Whether you can knock on a few doors in your own neighborhood or are willing to canvass elsewhere in the district, we'll provide everything you need to get started. We'll soon be announcing even more Town Hall dates coming up in August across the district, so if we aren't coming to your community yet, stay tuned! body:
RSVP for Boogie and Berge, check out upcoming events, and find a way to plug in this week.

| | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | | | |
# This Week with Team Berge
Hi Team Berge,
Thank you for being part of this campaign. Every event, conversation, yard sign, social share, and volunteer shift helps us build momentum across Wisconsin’s 3rd Congressional District. Below are a few upcoming opportunities to show up, volunteer, and help Emily connect with voters. Whether you have a full afternoon or just a little time to give, there is a way to plug in.
**Have a question about an event or how to get involved? Just reply to this email and we will help get you connected.**
---
| |
# Boogie with Berge!
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | |

Join us for Boogie with Berge, a free, high-energy evening of music, dancing, and community at The Plus in Eau Claire. Come enjoy live music, connect with other supporters, and help us build momentum as we get out the vote for Emily.

---
| [RSVP](https://us.list-manage.com/1AQDpNscMKm?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)
---
| |
# Upcoming Volunteer Opportunities
From parades and community events to meet and greets and local gatherings, these moments give voters a chance to see the campaign in action. Volunteers help make that possible.
Wear your Berge shirt or button, bring your energy, and help with things like greeting guests, signing people in, taking photos, handing out materials, or simply showing visible support.

**Event support sign-up:**[**** July Volunteer Sign-Up](https://us.list-manage.com/yBxydlw9KTC?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)**| Parade sign-up:**[**** Parade Sign-Up](https://us.list-manage.com/V3sRCg1BSOR?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)

**Friday, July 10**(3:00pm-5:00pm) - River Falls Fundraiser**Friday, July 10**(5:30pm lineup-6:00pm start) - River Falls Day Parade**Friday, July 10**(6:30pm-8:30pm) - Eau Claire Meet & Greet**Saturday, July 11**(10:30am lineup / 11:00am start) - Wa Du Shuda Days Parade in New Lisbon**Saturday, July 11**(1:30pm lineup-2:00pm start) - Black River Falls Festival in the Park Parade**Sunday, July 12**(12:30pm lineup / 1:00pm start) - Catfish Days Parade in Trempealeau**Monday, July 13**(5:00pm-8:00pm) - Pittsville Picnic**Wednesday, July 15**(5:30pm-7:30pm) - Tomah Fundraiser**Friday, July 17**(5:00pm-8:00pm) - Eau Claire Meet & Greet
---
| |
# Canvassing Opportunities
---
| |

One of the biggest ways we can support Emily is by having real conversations with voters. Canvassing, phone banking, texting, and writing postcards all help us reach people across the whole district.
Here are some upcoming canvassing launches for you to join![Sign up here](https://us.list-manage.com/kwhCuzHWTVq?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)

**Thursday, July 9**(12:00pm) - Knock doors in La Crosse**Saturday, July 11**(11:00am) - Knock doors in La Crosse**Saturday, July 11**(10:00am) - Knock doors in Eau Claire**Saturday, July 11**(10:00am) - Knock doors in Stevens Point**Thursday, July 16**(12:00pm) - Knock doors in La Crosse**Saturday, July 18**(1:00pm) - Knock doors in Eau Claire**Saturday, July 18**(10:00am) - Knock doors in Stevens Point**Saturday, July 18**(11:00am) - Knock doors in La CrosseWant to canvass in your own community, phone bank, or send postcards? You don’t need to be an expert to get started. We will make sure you have everything you need and are trained, just use this [Canvassing Form](https://us.list-manage.com/6nnn1004X0N?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1) and we will get back to you shortly.
---
| |
# More ways to support Emily
Not everyone can attend an event every week, and that is okay. There are still simple ways to help build visibility and momentum. If you are attending a local festival, farmers market, concert, fair, or community gathering, consider some of these other ways to support Emily:Request a Berge yard sign:[ Yard Sign Request Form](https://us.list-manage.com/mmGHt2rv7q7?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)Order a Berge shirt and wear it to events, parades, and around town:[ Order Your Shirt Today](https://us.list-manage.com/Z7M_20CfAye?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)Submit a written testimonial about why you are supporting Emily:[ Submit a Story](https://us.list-manage.com/1qKZQLFdMyl?e=1362dd258a&c2id=d51b517ba2e5c823fe0a3e4f0e8330f1)Host a postcard writing party with friends, family, or neighbors. This is a great way to help reach voters while building community.Boost social media engagement by liking, commenting on, and sharing campaign posts. Follow Berge for Congress on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, and Bluesky.Wear your Berge button around town. Volunteers have shared great stories about conversations started with neighbors, cashiers, servers, and community members just by wearing a button.
---
| |
# Thank you for being a part of Team Berge!
---

Peter,
Greg Abbott has been hoarding $27 billion in taxpayer dollars, and at a time when Texans are struggling to afford the basics, I’m going to put that money where it belongs: with Texans.
Greg Abbott could use these billions from the government for relief for everyday Texans. **Yet, somehow, he easily finds the funds to hand corporate tech giants the most generous data center tax giveaways in the country** — all because Big Tech filled his campaign coffers with cash.
The real problem is that most Texans don’t know the true extent of Abbott’s corruption. But when voters learn the truth, we’ll have a clear path to victory.
[**Peter, will you chip in $5 right now to help us get the truth out to voters across Texas?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260708_1_money.fcagBU&refcode=em20260708-1523&amount=5&t=1&akid=1523%2E299639%2EnmXcS-)

[****](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260708_1_money.fcagBU&refcode=em20260708-1523&amount=5&t=2&akid=1523%2E299639%2EnmXcS-)
The only way we win this race is by fighting for every single vote — which means no town is too far, and no community is too small. From now until Election Day, we are showing up everywhere Texans are ready to be heard.
At every single stop, we’re talking directly with folks about how Abbott is hoarding $27 billion of our money and handing out no-bid contracts to his political donors.
We are also sharing our vision to fix it. When we win, we are going to return that money to whom it actually belongs by putting it back in your pocket with $1,500 checks.
But driving across a state this massive takes serious resources. Just traveling from Austin to El Paso is over eight hours and 500 miles. And we can only keep up this pace with your help.
**[Will you chip in $5 today to help keep us on the road, cover our gas, and bring more Texans into this fight to win in November?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260708_1_money.fcagBU&refcode=em20260708-1523&amount=5&t=3&akid=1523%2E299639%2EnmXcS-)**

subject: A Vote on Trump’s Arch

body:
Tomorrow, the National Capital Planning Commission is going to meet in Washington, DC. The first item on the meeting’s agenda is Trump’s arch.
#
Peter,
Tomorrow, the National Capital Planning Commission is going to meet in Washington, DC. The first item on the meeting’s agenda is Trump’s arch.
If you think the Capital Planning Commission is an esteemed body with the best interests of the people of the country at heart, it is currently run by:
**William Scharf** , Trump’s White House Staff Secretary
**Stuart Levenbach** , Trump’s Chief Statistician
And **James Blair** , Trump’s Deputy Chief of Staff (and the guy running his entire midterm political operation)
They’re voting on the final design of the Arc de Trump, and conveniently, they’ve included mock ups. Here’s the view from Arlington House to the Lincoln Memorial today:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-jul26.EhtcQh&refcode=em260708-1-120&t=1&akid=35318%2E3013755%2ExBn8eD)
And here’s what it’ll look like if they approve Trump’s monstrosity:
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-jul26.EhtcQh&refcode=em260708-1-120&t=2&akid=35318%2E3013755%2ExBn8eD)
Frankly, it’s worse than we thought. Which is saying quite a bit, as we already assumed it was going to look like complete shit. But notice one thing: The direct line of sight between the Lincoln Memorial and Arlington House, and the graves of the fallen surrounding it at Arlington National Cemetery, is broken.
When they were planning the location of the Lincoln Memorial, its orientation, the surrounding features, the site was intentional. The view — from Arlington House and Arlington National Cemetery to our solemn memorial to the man who saved the United States from dissolution — was intentional.
That view is more significant than Trump, or his politically appointed stooges, or this ridiculous arch. It is a symbol of everything the Civil War was fought for: freedom for all, equality for all, the reunion of this nation, and the reconciliation of our people.
Trump wants to break that, and put the graves of the fallen in his shadow. Scharf, Levenbach, and Blair are going to vote to approve that arch, and they’re going to do it because Trump told them to. But that doesn’t matter.
We are going to hound this arch at every step. VoteVets is going to build a national opposition that will stop it in its tracks. And when we retake Congress in November the people we send will do what the Republicans won’t: Tell Trump no.
[**Please. Make a donation to VoteVets and support us as we raise hell about this arch. It has to be stopped, and we won’t rest until that happens.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-jul26.EhtcQh&refcode=em260708-1-120&t=3&akid=35318%2E3013755%2ExBn8eD)

clean_body: Our work is far from over. | | | Peter, As we work to build a government that serves the people over the powerful, one of the best tools for us to plan for the fights ahead is monthly recurring donations from members like you. Monthly donations allow us to invest strategically in candidates and legislation that work for working people, knowing that we’ll have the resources to finish out this election cycle strong. Support from members like you has already powered so many important victories this year — from helping congressional candidates Brad Lander, Melat Kiros, Analilia Mejia, Randy Villegas, Mai Vang, Chris Rabb, and more win their primary elections, to providing crucial support for legislators holding the line on not funding ICE, to introducing the planks of the Working Families Guarantee. But our work is far from over. With even more primaries around the corner in Michigan and Tennessee, hundreds of seats to win in November, and the constant need to stand up to MAGA extremists and corporate moderates — here are just a few of the things recurring donations help pay for: Hiring organizers to build the movement for working class power across the country. Running trainings for candidates and campaign staff, so people from all backgrounds have the skills to lead their community. Rallies, lobbying days, and letter campaigns to pass priority legislation like paid sick leave and taxing the rich at the local, state, and federal levels. Outreach to voters about candidates that will fight for us, including TV, radio, and digital ads, mailers, phone banks, text banks, and canvass operations. There is no path for Democrats to take back the House without flipping this district.
It’s that simple. With the way redistricting is being weaponized by the GOP, we cannot afford to leave winnable battleground seats like this one on the table.
Kamala won this seat by 1% in 2024. Lawler won it by 7%. That means there are tens of thousands of split-ticket voters we need to convince.
And your investment of $10 or $17 makes a big difference in terms of how many of them that we are able to reach from now until November. I’m counting on this grassroots team to help us take on the MAGA dark money that is already flooding into our district.
I’m humbly asking:
[If flipping NY-17 and taking back the House is worth $10 to you, can you please make a donation to my campaign? | | friend,
As one of my top supporters, I want to give you a brief campaign update.
I’ve been traveling across the state meeting with oil and gas producers, large and small, to determine the best path forward for the Texas Railroad Commission.
And one subject that continues to pop up - my opponent, Jon Rosenthal, is a threat to the Texas Miracle.
That’s one reason why I received the endorsement of the Panhandle Producers and Royalty Owners Association.
**_The people who know and rely on oil and gas understand that I am the only candidate who will safeguard the Texas Miracle_.**
For this position, it’s important to have someone who can protect this critical industry, as well as the rights of landowners. I’m the only candidate qualified to do both.
**_I have worked for decades in oil and gas and have also dealt with environmental issues caused by wells on my own property. Unlike my opponent, I understand both sides_.**
Your decision for RRC this November is one of the most important you will make.
Real Texas landmen, as well as landowners, know the responsible choice is Bo French, NOT Radical Rosenthal.
While Rosenthal continues to cozy up to Bloomberg, Soros, and communist environmental groups, I will continue to travel the state, building our movement, and earning the vote of everyday Texans.
**_You can join me in my mission by clicking the link below to help out our campaign._**
After all, this is a team effort. We will need all hands on deck to keep Texas Oil and Gas out of the hands of Radical Rosenthal.

name: Dr. Annie Andrews
subject: I'm a doctor. I'm scared. And I'm running for Senate.
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-andrews [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-andrews]
I'm a pediatrician. I’m pissed. I’m scared. And I need your help to defeat Lindsey Graham in the U.S. Senate.
I’m not the “monsters-under-the-bed” kind of scared. I’m the “I’ve watched children suffer from preventable illness and injury while politicians do absolutely nothing” kind of scared.
I’ve treated kids who’ve been shot. Kids whose families struggle to afford their medications.
Kids who live with mold that causes asthma attacks, miss school for climate disasters, and watch politicians use them as political pawns.
And now? Trump is causing chaos and Lindsey Graham is right by his side.
And Medicaid — the program that keeps half our pediatric patients insured, healthy, and...alive — is on the chopping block to pay for tax breaks for billionaires.
So yeah, I never planned to run for Senate.
But I’m scared. I’m pissed. I’m motivated. And I’m 100% in.
I’m running for Senate in South Carolina to defeat Lindsey Graham and to fight for the kids no one in D.C. seems to be thinking about. So I need you with me.
We need to hit 10,000 donations before July 15th to prove that this campaign can go the distance. Can I count on you to split a donation with my campaign and Equal Opportunity Now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-andrews]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE TODAY TO DEFEAT LINDSEY GRAHAM! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-andrews]
I’m running because the Republican Party, led by people like Lindsey Graham, is dismantling the very systems that keep our kids safe here in South Carolina.
I’m running because the issues I care about — children’s healthcare, vaccines, gun violence, public education, Social Security, Medicaid and Medicare — are under direct attack right now.
And I’m running because I consider it my professional duty as a pediatrician — to give children a strong voice at the national level. Too many are comfortable on the sidelines. That won’t work for me.
We need bold leaders who aren’t afraid to fight. I am ready.
Even though the path will be hard, I know Lindsey Graham must be held accountable. He certainly doesn’t deserve a free pass back to D.C. for six more years.
That’s why I’m running for US Senate. To defeat Trump’s lapdog and fight for everyday Americans. But, I need your support today. Can you rush a split donation of $10 (or whatever you can spare) between Equal Opportunity Now and me to become a Founding Donor to my campaign? >> secure.actblue.com/flipSC [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-andrews]
Thank you for believing in this campaign,
Dr. Annie Andrews

I’ve spent my career in public service.

After college, I joined the Peace Corps. When I returned, I founded a legal clinic to help people living with AIDS access life-saving care in Deep South Mississippi. Later, I became a federal labor attorney, where I helped write the PRO Act to make it easier for workers to unionize and unrig our economy.

I know how to beat the Republicans and flip competitive seats. I did it on the San Diego City Council, and in office, I worked to ban untraceable ghost guns to keep our schools safe, and opposed utility rate hikes that hurt working families.

I’m proud to be part of the LGBTQ community. Like many of you, my partner and I are deeply worried that we may lose our rights to marriage equality under the Trump administration. Instead of respecting families like ours, Trump and his supporters have spent years vilifying people like me and attacking the LGBTQ community.

| | Derek, it’s Governor Wes Moore.

Five years ago, I had never run for political office. I was a former Army Captain, a dad to two young kids, and I ran one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country.

But I knew more had to be done. While career politicians were saying that everything was great, **I was hearing from folks all across Maryland who were feeling left behind.** So I ran for Governor with a mission to make Maryland a state that serves all our people — and won. (And I’m not done yet!)

# New Mexico is NOT for sale!
---
| | | | | | Friend,
The headlines this week say Deb Haaland out-raised our campaign 2-to-1 last month. Here's what those headlines won't tell you.
Since winning the Republican primary, our fundraising has picked up major steam. Of the 424 donations our campaign received in that month, 415 came from right here in New Mexico. From Albuquerque. From Santa Fe. From Rio Rancho. From people who actually have to live with the outcome of this election.
According to [_Source NM_](https://us.list-manage.com/4EeANEexMf5?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810), Deb Haaland took in more than 2,200 donations from California alone. Wealthy California liberals want to buy New Mexico and continue our downward spiral. I'm not interested in building a campaign on money from people who will never set foot in this state. I'm building mine on the support of the people who call it home. I have the support of New Mexicans. I'll take that trade every single day between now and November 3rd.
Let's be honest about something else. We've been outraised before. We were out-raised in the primary too, and we won anyway, because a message of proven results that connects with real voters beats a bigger bank account every time. Money doesn't buy elections in New Mexico. A record of results does.
I spent 12 years as Mayor of Rio Rancho. I kept Intel in our state. I more than doubled the police budget. I helped lead the city to national recognition for growth, job creation, and affordability. That's not a talking point built by a consultant in Washington. That's what I did, in this state, for the people of this state.
If you're with me, I need you to join me right now. A gift of $25, $50, or even $10 from a fellow New Mexican means more to this campaign than any out-of-state check ever could.
---

clean_body: Fellow American, I have been watching this race closely -- and I need you to hear me out. | FROM THE DESK OF SENATOR KATIE BRITT Fellow Patriot, As a mom, I think about the world my kids are going to inherit every single day. I think about the kind of country they will grow up in. Whether it will be safe. Whether they will have opportunities. Whether the values we are raising them with will still mean something when they are grown. That is why I fight so hard in the Senate. And that is why I am reaching out to you today about a race I believe will shape the future - Montana. This is Katie Britt, Alabama's first elected female Senator. I am a wife, a mom of two, and a conservative who believes that the best days of this country are still ahead of us - if we fight for them. Fellow Patriot, I do not reach out for just any race. But this one is different. If Chuck Schumer flips Montana, he takes back the Senate. Plain and simple. And if that happens, everything President Trump and conservatives are fighting for - the border, tax cuts, conservative judges, American energy - comes to a screeching halt. As a mom, that keeps me up at night. Montana is the firewall. And right now, that firewall needs our help. DEFEND THE SENATE MAJORITY: Kurt Alme is exactly who we need holding that line. He is a Montana native, a devoted husband and father, and a man who has spent his career serving his state. As a Trump-nominated federal prosecutor, he took on cartels, stood up to drug traffickers, and drove criminal prosecutions to a 20-year high. He delivered two of the largest income tax cuts in Montana history. He is tough, principled, and the kind of person you want in your corner when things get hard. President Trump gave Kurt his complete and total endorsement - and I am proud to stand with him, too. But, Fellow Patriot, Schumer is not backing down. Democrats raised $130 million on ActBlue in May alone. That money is being deployed right now - on ads, on organizers, on everything it takes to flood Montana with outside cash and buy a seat that belongs to the people of that great state. As a mom, I know what it means to fight for something bigger than yourself. I do it every day - for my kids, for Alabama, and for this country. What matters is that Kurt knows conservatives across this country have his back - and that the moms, dads, and families of this nation are not going to let Schumer win. The Senate majority runs through Montana. Let's protect it for our kids and for the future of our country. With gratitude, Katie Britt U.S. Senator for Alabama FOLLOW KURT ALME ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Alme for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go: .

# [Delta slices Premium Cabins into bare-bones "Basic Business" to squeeze every last dime](https://substack.com/redirect/c077a136-d8f3-46ed-be2b-cf71c0294ca0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Delta's turning first-class into a three-tier meat grinder just like United--new "Basic Business" fares strip lounge access, seat selection, miles, and flexibility while keeping the lie-flat seat. They've been planning this for over a year because high-spenders still pay up no matter how you gut the perks. Ruthless segmentation on steroidspremium demand stays rock-solid, costs get crushed, margins fatten.
* **• Winners?** Delta shareholders watching yield per seat explode, C-suite execs booking real Delta One, and the airline printing cash while travelers whine.
* **• Losers?** Business travelers thinking they're VIP but getting economy-plus treatment at premium prices, loyalty program suckers earning squat.
* **• Next?** United and the rest copycat fast, full premium unbundling across the board, fares creep higher while load factors stay golden.

Airlines are running the ultimate grift charge luxury prices for discount service and laugh all the way to record profits. This is how winners operate: give the illusion of choice, pocket the spread. Delta's showing the street how to monetize desperation. Buy the dips on any airline that learns this lesson quick; the rest get commoditized into oblivion. Smart money already positioned.

# [Used EV prices explode 12% on Iran War and $3.80 gas while new EVs rot on lots](https://substack.com/redirect/c077a136-d8f3-46ed-be2b-cf71c0294ca0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Iran chaos and pump prices up 21% year-over-year just turned used EVs into gold Manheim index jumped 12% last month versus 1.7% for gas guzzlers, wholesale averages now $30,400, retail listings $37k, Tesla leading sales up 24.7%. Meanwhile new EV deliveries crater. Classic supply-demand whiplash: gas pain makes batteries sexy again even as Detroit floods the market with discounts.
* • **Winners?** Used Tesla flippers, early EV owners cashing out fat, and anyone long battery metals riding the irony wave.
* • **Losers?** New EV makers bleeding inventory, legacy automakers who over-leased three years ago, and suckers who bought the "EV everything" hype at peak.
* • **Next?** Off-lease flood hits late 2026 but gas stays sticky on geopolitics so prices hold firm, used market stays hot while new ones get torched on pricing.

Gas spikes are the ultimate EV bullwhip exactly what the weak hands missed. This war premium just handed battery owners a get-rich exit while Detroit eats crow. The market rewards survivors who bought cheap used iron, not virtue-signal leases. Position for the spread: long used demand plays, short the new-car dinosaurs still chasing subsidies that vanished. Profit from the chaos they created.

# [BofA drops $520 million loan to OpenAI and lines up for the Trillion-Dollar IPO feast](https://substack.com/redirect/c077a136-d8f3-46ed-be2b-cf71c0294ca0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bank of America just wired OpenAI its first $520 million credit line ahead of the $1 trillion-plus IPO filing, positioning to advise both OpenAI and Anthropic while already banking $500 billion in AI capital raises since 2025. Same crew that bookran SpaceX's monster. Banks are smelling blood in the AI water and they're not waiting for the prospectus they're lending now to own the fees later.
* **• Winners?** BofA shareholders printing on every AI deal, OpenAI execs getting bridge cash before the listing pop, and every fintech shark circling the next unicorn.
* **• Losers?** Smaller banks shut out of the mega-mandates, retail waiting for crumbs, and anyone still pretending AI is a cottage industry.
* **• Next?** BofA bags advisory mandates, OpenAI prices north of $1 trillion, follow-on debt and equity orgy kicks off by Q4.

This is the feeding frenzy I **[called](https://substack.com/redirect/a1a7ab0d-406a-4372-a5f9-17781f285522?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , naysayers get ignored while the money printers line up. Banks don't care about safety theater; they care about the green. Smart money rides the underwriter wave all the way to the listing bell. The AI IPO pipeline is the new gold rush and BofA just staked the prime claim. Load bank stocks that get it; the rest watch from the sidelines broke.

# [McDonald's franchisees grind for peanuts while the Golden Arches Corp prints like crazy](https://substack.com/redirect/c077a136-d8f3-46ed-be2b-cf71c0294ca0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Turns out owning a McDonald's is a $1-2.2 million trap that nets surprisingly thin after forking over 4% royalty, 10.7% rent, and buying all supplies from HQ, corporation pockets 82% of franchise revenue versus just 16% from company stores. Chick-fil-A operators clear almost double. Upfront cash requirement $400k-$880k minimum, total fees eat 15%+ of sales. Classic corporate extraction machine.
* **• Winners?** McDonald's shareholders collecting the royalty stream without the real estate headaches, corporate execs banking fat bonuses on franchisee labor.
* **• Losers?** Aspiring franchisees who mortgaged everything for a glorified shift-manager gig, small operators watching Chick-fil-A eat their lunch.
* **• Next?** More franchisee lawsuits or buyback pressure, stock keeps ripping while owners beg for relief, Wall Street loves the model.

This is capitalism at its most beautiful corporation turns entrepreneurs into cash cows and keeps the golden goose. Own the ticker, never the store. My take: franchise dreams are for suckers; equity in the house that extracts is where real wealth gets built. The street already knows stock outperforms owning the fryer any day. Lesson learned the hard way for anyone chasing the "be your own boss" lie.

Turns out owning a McDonald's is a $1-2.2 million trap that nets surprisingly thin after forking over 4% royalty, 10.7% rent, and buying all supplies from HQ, corporation pockets 82% of franchise revenue versus just 16% from company stores. Chick-fil-A operators clear almost double. Upfront cash requirement $400k-$880k minimum, total fees eat 15%+ of sales. Classic corporate extraction machine. • Winners? McDonald's shareholders collecting the royalty stream without the real estate headaches, corporate execs banking fat bonuses on franchisee labor. • Losers? Aspiring franchisees who mortgaged everything for a glorified shift-manager gig, small operators watching Chick-fil-A eat their lunch. • Next? More franchisee lawsuits or buyback pressure, stock keeps ripping while owners beg for relief, Wall Street loves the model. This is capitalism at its most beautiful corporation turns entrepreneurs into cash cows and keeps the golden goose. Own the ticker, never the store. My take: franchise dreams are for suckers; equity in the house that extracts is where real wealth gets built. The street already knows stock outperforms owning the fryer any day. Lesson learned the hard way for anyone chasing the "be your own boss" lie. Let us know your thoughts. | | Dear Faithful Friend,
This year, as we mark 250 years in this great experiment in liberty, I keep asking myself the same question: _**Are we keeping the faith?** _
Let me explain what I mean.
At the very heart of it, _we were born a nation of Christian pilgrims and dissenters. _
The Pilgrims. The Puritans. The Quakers. The Huguenots. The German Pietists. Wave after wave of men and women who crossed an ocean because they refused to let any earthly power stand between them and their biblical faith in the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob – the God revealed in Jesus Christ.
_That is the seed America grew from_ , and every time we’ve forgotten this, we’ve gone astray.
The very first freedom in the Bill of Rights – the one the framers put first, not fifth or tenth, but first – is **the freedom to worship God without interference from government**. That wasn’t random. It was the whole point.
And when people knock our founding fathers as relics of a bygone era who “wouldn’t understand the world today,” I ask you to think about our brothers and sisters in Christ today, _right now_ , in places like Nigeria, Iran, Pakistan, North Korea and many other places.
**There are an estimated 388 million Christian men, women and children being persecuted, oppressed and ruthlessly murdered simply for loving Jesus.**
Here in America, _it’s almost impossible to know what that’s like_ , but we do have the freedom, the platform and the resources to support them, and fight back in a wide range of ways. **The question is, will we?**
I can’t help but feel that this year, on the 250th birthday of the world’s most indispensable Christian nation, that we have a duty to rededicate ourselves to God and to the defense of His people around the world. **And today, I’m asking you to partner with me and an incredible organization in that endeavor.**
**There is no organization in this country more committed to that fight than Save the Persecuted Christians, where I’m proud to serve as a board member.** ** ** Whether it’s the growing awareness of the active genocide against Nigeria’s Christians (and recent U.S. action to help stop it), or the recent and very real victories against the rise of sharia and Islamism here in America, it is due in very large part to the relentless advocacy and education campaigns of Save the Persecuted Christians and the coalition of 200+ organizations they help to guide.
[ **As we commemorate America’s 250th birthday, I humbly but urgently ask that you help to supercharge their efforts with a generous, tax-deductible contribution.** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=996a43ca36c74c219a08ead79f5fe055&_e=jil0c4DEFpl36CUjv53V9Ny9qXROAsmaS4-n6sZ9oiiYWlQG4emiPwhENPIVl2uPU8LfuKhjFYc0m0gtMCIrKG6JeiICy_LHo35yWneAAZtFezE6O4Cc24kZf_MbeIsnk6Dy7EuRhTQgZte1wo6zGPgJb2-8yLf5R9FBmiHC5OprAXpZT4xXEf6iau9uCJgEoITDokzk-Jw6kr47bSebSDb5xFu7mpi9FGCSxz73s8l9dxe0XmOrt-gGmxQdaSBVN699Ozd35PJ5f-47YFnN586JiC73k5AsvsfXiFsLfMIm3LCwkOid6e4zD4QtZkWs76z7G-tdROKc-U3q9_Be6iD5zC-CzZj1PY1kRG-3KTXmVrRpfZAvx-GEs4_CCwNQVSCPMdrBBPMlAOCVC0NfyhbQhJucwXmR8wGbQrJOPeQOlhsIQ-5zFCFYnYi2cPI9AYUido8caCHiX9vDqi1vKKZsCC_tkvhZxXfK8GLrCCzC_LknJPBqQTEP7Mov1fXDZOsURY9R_rfZl8M9EFTimtS6Gx7ro8apP2LieY3FwCCE1yCi6mD2vl9QIsRguerS6HJh366gQRjA5D717a8X8pYy1vkWeYyboeekCF-j-rUFwPg-k-69jrwUU0M7EMM6pO1NgLcm7dGoAj9UFLIscwQ08hdmRwNjzSXoJwTJtrpCVgx6ee_iDwEJ9BsbD3dD-8kZ-fIL3MRdwMppDtbYVJtw6axerLDApy4dI6IcFA0XAAXgdpcjst3-lOiRPhfe)

As you contemplate your potential commitment, I ask you to think about this.
**While Christians in America today are the freest Christians in the history of the world, 388 million of our brothers and sisters, in other parts of the world, are being hunted for practicing the same faith that built this country.**
Every generation that ever mattered to the kingdom of God understood that faith without action is sentiment – and sentiment has never freed a single soul.
**Now it's our turn.**
Two hundred and fifty years ago, the founders pledged their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor. _They paid the price._ They handed us the inheritance. The only real question this year is what we do with it.
On July 3, 1776 – one day after the Continental Congress had voted to declare independence – John Adams sat down in Philadelphia and wrote to his wife Abigail.
He told her this new American holiday " _ought to be commemorated, as the Day of Deliverance, by solemn Acts of Devotion to God Almighty. It ought to be solemnized with Pomp and Parade, with Shews, Games, Sports, Guns, Bells, Bonfires and Illuminations, from one End of this Continent to the other, from this Time forward forever more._ "
Notice the order. _First solemn devotion to God._ Then the fireworks.
250 years later, we’ve kept the fireworks. But the question is, have we maintained the devotion?
I believe we still can. **This anniversary is bigger than a birthday party. It is a reckoning** – with our history, with our blessings, and with our obligations to the brothers and sisters around the world who are paying the highest possible price for the very faith we still get to practice openly.
They are praying for a Church that does not always remember their names.
On this 250th birthday – of all years – we have the chance to tell them they are not forgotten.
[ **That is what your gift does. That is what Save the Persecuted Christians does. And that is why, I am asking you to give as generously as you possibly can.** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=996a43ca36c74c219a08ead79f5fe055&_e=jil0c4DEFpl36CUjv53V9Ny9qXROAsmaS4-n6sZ9oiiYWlQG4emiPwhENPIVl2uPU8LfuKhjFYc0m0gtMCIrKG6JeiICy_LHo35yWneAAZtFezE6O4Cc24kZf_MbeIsnk6Dy7EuRhTQgZte1wo6zGPgJb2-8yLf5R9FBmiHC5OprAXpZT4xXEf6iau9uCJgEoITDokzk-Jw6kr47bSebSDb5xFu7mpi9FGCSxz73s8l9dxe0XmOrt-gGmxQdaSBVN699Ozd35PJ5f-47YFnN589lI2H_PdpMMlhTBSN31yci3veiuCylpFDt2ALdR7SQpclfvvqUV3CoBdxPpvFB2Z5QMhq6kmaHeqr2BBbWCEjQ0lDeCPNYCUJ-7mMiEJo4g-FBcezREmTUvKpN2sAmf7gr_SqB-jFCY37rQMG0xlE7Ch-iMCiHvpovJE67Kv67jYUYT80J3ivEIcwxbf0U2Plqqmd8qbLOmxoPCDzCZqD6eoAYgT2vq7uLu1Cq5ntMCY8z3-PpBaQlKIrXxyYSsMOT2ksuD2jDZxEEhs-cV5H028kAHCdQQiswX43UUv390_Lpy9q-7CxYAAnzYMqGRXiRPL1bp1YmXU6TcGqsDc5E7a6nM2mHHxvmDFIZA_5c-VqxLZN_sKQkgulGEmugEtXQeXc3MTggbYFcTrcfRQAdRxrV39HZlnKWrYvgNjrs79-EA2QsmVCmvuYqYUM69D881bjiIVSsWjU1Q_PJtEMrN6Hhv0ILASSkCPQ6TfGX)

Here's the thing: James got on our volunteer call because he knows what we know — this race isn't going to be decided by cable news hits or Ken Paxton's dark money. It's going to be decided by the meeting, registering and turning out the margin of victory. James Talarico is betting on our work. Are you with us? More soon, Powered by People

https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
Last week, ICE agents detained more than 10,000 people after doubling their daily quota. Right now, people detained are being denied basic human rights. When I visited the California City Detention Center, I saw people being denied medical attention. I saw rocks in the food. I saw people shivering because they didn’t have clothes.
This isn't law enforcement. It's an agency operating with too little accountability and too much power.
That's why I'm calling to abolish ICE and replace it with an agency that respects the Constitution, the rule of law, and basic human rights.
ADD YOUR NAME: Support my plan to stop ICE’s abuse of power. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/ice-reform-plan-petition?contactdata=lYTlVwoXSFDN9FGQAkmSK8+wYFMqRjBux0ATkVw0hqKFo3xCvEOjuFHYAH+0Ym3KmaCsEDTkABk7XK2vLpkdszQX4v/aJRA82C2S54p7rwefWONcy17tJr4LQisiPbWAHW+9ah+ea/j8smiv8f+GayJbFwFt+BozhPIydhEfvfqE69Hd0gaDKr+jlZEItKZJ]
https://x.com/rokhanna/status/2074564998303482199?s=46 [https://x.com/rokhanna/status/2074564998303482199?s=46]
Here’s what we are demanding:
✅ Vote no on any DHS bill that funds ICE.
✅ Repeal the multi-year $75 billion funding for ICE.
✅ End qualified immunity for ICE agents.
✅ Investigate and prosecute every single ICE agent who broke the law.
✅ End the Kavanaugh stops with racial profiling and the militarization of ICE.
✅ Codify a use-of-force standard so courts can enforce the law against rogue ICE agents.
✅ Tear down and replace ICE with an agency that has oversight.
✅ Prohibit masks and mandate body cameras and visible identification for immigration officers.
✅ Establish human rights standards at immigration detention facilities.

# The Primary Relay

### _We’re Giving It Our All_
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

This primary race is coming to a close. We are passing the other candidates and bringing our entire relay team to the finish line.
In today's politics, it is easy to confuse being seen with being known. Campaigns spend millions making sure voters recognize a name, but recognition is not the same as trust.**Elizabeth Dempsey Beggs has chosen a different path** because democracy is not at its strongest when leaders ask people to simply believe in them; it is strongest when trust is built one conversation at a time. She is earning that trust the old-fashioned way by running every mile of Virginia's First District, listening to voters, and proving that every community deserves to be heard.
With**** l**ess than one month until Election Day** , every remaining mile matters. Every conversation Elizabeth has is another opportunity to earn a vote before ballots are cast. This campaign is not built on big-money donors or political consultants. It is built on showing up, putting in the work, and earning the privilege of representing Virginia's First District. There are still voters to reach, and time is running short.
If you believe Virginia deserves a representative who earns trust instead of buying attention, now is the time to help. Chip in **$20** today to **sponsor the next mile** and power this campaign through the final month. Every contribution helps Elizabeth reach another community before Election Day.

name: More Perfect Union
subject: Want Social Security to be there for you in retirement? Here’s how:
body:
It’s time for the wealthy to pay their fair share in Social Security contributions.
#
Hi there,
If you have a MAGA uncle who watches a lot of Fox News, you may have been hearing the doomsday warnings that Social Security is going broke and therefore we need to make “cuts” to save it. Here are the facts.
Social Security is not going broke. It has a trust fund that ensures the program has money for the future. But let’s be honest: that trust fund is being depleted, because we have growing numbers of retirees and fewer workers to pay contributions into that trust fund.
The good news is that there’s a very simple solution to this problem.
As you know, Social Security is funded through payroll (FICA) taxes. While most Americans pay into Social Security with every paycheck, once you earn $184,500 annually, your contributions stop. That means a person earning $10 million a year stops paying after about a week into January of every year.
**We need Congress to act to eliminate the earned income cap on Social Security contributions and expand benefits for all Americans.** If we did this, we could extend the solvency of Social Security’s trust fund by 75 years and meaningfully expand benefits for low-income seniors living in poverty.
It’s past time for the wealthy to pay their fair share. Add your name if you agree:
**[Tell Congress to scrap the earned income cap on Social Security. The wealthiest Americans should contribute out of every paycheck, just the same as the rest of us.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22897?t=1&akid=1679%2E2118727%2E0JEBX5)**
Here are three things you need to know to debate your right-wing uncle on Social Security:
**1\. The alleged Social Security crisis is not inevitable – it is a policy choice.** The politicians who tell us that the program is going broke are the same ones who voted for a 2025 tax law (“One Big Beautiful Bill”) that reduced Social Security's revenue.
**2\. The fix is simple: require the wealthy to pay their fair share.** Right now, they pay nothing in Social Security taxes on earned income over $184,500. That means the ultra-wealthy stop contributing after a matter of hours or days into the year, while a middle-class income earner pays all year long. We can extend Social Security’s solvency by 75 years if we do this.
**3\. A real crisis facing Social Security is inadequate staffing following Elon Musk's DOGE.** Without enough customer service representatives, many offices have shut down and Americans are struggling to access the benefits they earned. This has been a backdoor way that the right-wing is trying to undermine Social Security.
The question on Social Security essentially comes down to this: Should we reduce benefits for seniors, or have the wealthy pay their fair share?
Medicare used to have the same contributions cap as Social Security. We scrapped the Medicare cap entirely in the 1990s. Now we can do the same for Social Security this year and stop scaring seniors about the risk of benefit cuts.
If you agree it's time to bring more money into Social Security by requiring high-income earners to contribute their fair share, then I hope you'll add your name today.
[**Sign our petition to tell Congress it's time to scrap the earned income cap on Social Security and ensure all Americans receive their earned benefits.** ](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22897?t=2&akid=1679%2E2118727%2E0JEBX5)
Thanks for showing where you stand on this issue.
In solidarity,
Faiz Shakir
Founder, More Perfect Union

Hey folks,
This one gets heated.
[Adam Mockler](https://open.substack.com/users/72893096-adam-mockler?utm_source=mentions) and I dig into the growing questions surrounding Mitch McConnell's disappearance from public view, why independent media has been leading this story while much of the mainstream press has stayed silent, and what all of it says about the broken incentives in Washington. We also talk about McConnell's political legacy, transparency in government, and why accountability can't be optional--no matter which party is involved.
**Here are some moments you don 't want to miss:**
* **00:01:07** Why Governor Andy Beshear is demanding answers about Mitch McConnell's health--and why transparency matters for anyone holding public office.
* **00:04:23** We break down the bizarre claims surrounding McConnell's alleged phone calls, why so many people aren't buying them, and what this says about the culture of political cover-ups.
* **00:07:05** A deep dive into McConnell's legacy--from reshaping the Supreme Court to changing the way power is wielded in Washington--and why those consequences will last for decades.
* **00:10:02** We compare how Republicans and Democrats handle scandal, accountability, and leadership, and debate whether Congress needs term limits, cognitive testing, and stronger transparency rules.
* **00:16:32** We wrap up by looking at the internet's reaction to the story, the viral parody posts that took over social media, and why independent media keeps forcing conversations that others won't.

This conversation isn't really about one senator. It's about whether Americans deserve honesty from the people who represent them, whether transparency still matters in our democracy, and why independent media has become so essential in holding powerful people accountable.
If you care about honest conversations like this--and want to help us keep asking the questions others won't--your support makes all the difference.

subject: Billionaires now have even greater influence in our elections

body:

Friend,
Last week, Donald Trump’s Supreme Court ruled to open the floodgates for more big money to pour into our elections. Now, billionaires and heavyweight donors will have even greater influence in our politics, while the voices of ordinary Americans get pushed out.
This is the same Supreme Court that just gutted the Voting Rights Act – allowing Republicans to gerrymander maps to dilute Black voices and drag us back to the dark and ugly days of Jim Crow. Meanwhile, Trump’s allies in Congress are working to pass the SAVE Act, which is nothing more than a voter suppression bill.
**Our democracy is on fire, friend, and I’m deeply angry about it.****** And I know you are, too. I believe that the answer to those who are attacking our democracy is to fight back with more democracy – to raise our voices louder than ever.
**That’s why I’m asking for your help to send a clear message to Donald Trump and his allies that we will not sit back and let ourselves get squeezed out of our democracy. We will fight back with everything we have. Can I count on you?**

Hey Peter,

Let me tell you a little bit about my story and why I am running for Senate in Montana.

I was born in Great Falls where my dad taught high school math & my mom taught elementary school. Growing up, we didn't have a lot, but we had everything that mattered: hard work, faith, and a deep sense of what it means to serve others.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=57bb49fbe1a0494ea6a9fda09290b359&_e=No7VP2N5IjbmpNZseiQDeOPPbSk7MLE38OzDXYDKd6lTb1wdjdsEIBrNTTuKkuwr7QKshZAxr9Vqt9o47dUiv7KbiI4CEhK2OXZeANMbfZAHgMEj2s_42GS7a-sEFpyu6mzzG9tkHwNk-2_cNc8CXxuwSP-C8eOENrUReAnbObkWkGkfkUCQ2DE9MRQA4SzilblSuf4-O_RaU9K2kqb6y27PRCFESvf98KM4c7sPJ0hHqlP0ZwMIUPLOf9ZIgp0WCuQvmMrIJak8Ss6uCm05ihsvcFAcfa4Q8LpxUiNTDNrsE2DOM8sRJ5CLlCoh0Df59InE4SWPCKlqOFfDqu50Ge8G30HlafeZFXoZG8KZmEWsXOyoFX1MkKaSRGdPrUOEJ2K4n1j-xdSnNn5NykRMNxfJbMzX0W1dpD49HZc7bNW-ablu6eyfko4yCSyF_msMz4K8wgLMkj1EvshyfyvVNODR-SiWp9N9pvKQel05ztackbpMkmGmF7oNbVZwh8hZqzlvAlNeGaMo9_oCvW7lHCguEsQl3dbFiMRr1Nw6b9QgZDxHzjphNZkaa81m8hjxp8DjvygRkmL4DPe5c6q_0ay2B_joFDMXdlCbs7zQZ_S7UyPVNVcaUqe1iQqJWv-QJsaOR7dcDahH9-cgRx8V1CiTwDxMdMu3wvobGhoCRUk55PI33Q5ldxOKpkGqCk3uvqz3i6FQEJNmAFSqcq50XQ%3D%3D)
We moved around a good amount – Dillon, Victor, Helena, and Miles City. Places that are the backbone of our nation. Towns where neighbors show up for each other, and everyone knows everyone. That is the Montana I grew up in. That is the Montana I am fighting to protect.

I built my legal career here. I raised my two kids here with my wife Sandra of 32 years. Montana has always been home, and that is never going to change.

I am proud to have served this state. As Director of the Department of Revenue, I spearheaded the largest income tax rate cut in Montana history — nearly 40%. As Budget Director, I helped cut wasteful spending, deliver another one of Montana’s largest tax cuts, and put Montana on track to be debt-free.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=57bb49fbe1a0494ea6a9fda09290b359&_e=No7VP2N5IjbmpNZseiQDeOPPbSk7MLE38OzDXYDKd6lTb1wdjdsEIBrNTTuKkuwr7QKshZAxr9Vqt9o47dUiv7KbiI4CEhK2OXZeANMbfZAHgMEj2s_42GS7a-sEFpyu6mzzG9tkHwNk-2_cNc8CXxuwSP-C8eOENrUReAnbObkWkGkfkUCQ2DE9MRQA4SzilblSuf4-O_RaU9K2kqb6y27PRCFESvf98KM4c7sPJ0hHqlP0ZwMIUPLOf9ZIgp0W50wF1_DC7LF0Cr0J-NsyzXu3CUgN_GURWgQG2-v4OaIo5h0EZqeKw9ssIazgvG0Gkwv7gRaiphXZDGoGM97xdQJz8LNpCEEdyaVubaM690RUTQuE5vSnU9RNR9GL89k7OUbIaT8XV-vWjGKC23NqeDw2SKFDX8BNjalQVD5te0ps9TRDTh2yHK-_tjks_90hL69L476IBSggngBhMNR3ZmDWrqj3TgMbgc2pWW1UdWFjhRweNSjawHXu6R_hcGG9iQK4gtTfwLQKitOsewqoupjyxjvH5kdwIIwWcRb_5-dC_Kd7vccT0HWG5KXZGlqM25koRpyQSwW7cQYOrZLrj-ucc_LhcCXmtlNsKv3UPItn7y_NVPCrzmfucz7iPwk2ZvXpzUnTKnC7vsCdJTZLT67sZS0RBBRZnnOOSsGjl4tTQ1PSpvpoojMTgskOoJ-EKW8YLiuWV9FHVtaSKVfIEQ%3D%3D)
President Trump nominated me twice to be Montana's US Attorney. During my time in that role, we went after drug traffickers and violent criminals who were endangering our communities. We stood up to the cartels. We drove criminal prosecutions to a 20-year high. Montana families deserve to feel safe – and we delivered.

Peter, I have never run for office before. But I am running now because the stakes have never been higher. Chuck Schumer has made Montana a top target. He knows that flipping this seat hands him back the Senate so he can stonewall President Trump's agenda.

Montana deserves a senator who has lived here, worked here, and will never stop fighting for the people here. **That is who I am,**and that is why I am asking for your support today.****

**[Will you chip in $25, $50, or whatever you can to help us keep Montana red and protect President Trump's Senate majority?](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=57bb49fbe1a0494ea6a9fda09290b359&_e=No7VP2N5IjbmpNZseiQDeOPPbSk7MLE38OzDXYDKd6lTb1wdjdsEIBrNTTuKkuwr7QKshZAxr9Vqt9o47dUiv7KbiI4CEhK2OXZeANMbfZAHgMEj2s_42GS7a-sEFpyu6mzzG9tkHwNk-2_cNc8CXxuwSP-C8eOENrUReAnbObkWkGkfkUCQ2DE9MRQA4SzilblSuf4-O_RaU9K2kqb6y27PRCFESvf98KM4c7sPJ0hHqlP0ZwMIUPLOf9ZIgp0WuAPA8FpyC78YQd_JGEDdmlo3DoZi9XJWxLC40pmVXC6DCXOzAO_dFWWqMH72NcnC4JhkDEOmjSlH0IiwTQsPdm7nO0WVXS5zbwXRKy2B2FvoX829JoFKRPo_Y3_ezMxDzgHeipsf2zPQQqhEvvqxXF3Yjzun2tnD4DitWPWOzLJM-rrvdqha3nHmtP9Be677XjGNQb-anQ1XOxDNxr_YnkBt01IuEUiB9YXuFEk2DrgRdI0G9ZipdwKs6Q_6Y94IqslX2Lz6Vn6kzZTlf88aOiVNlVLt-bZINsp7Whfks7VfsceW8pqpbcKIeoL_EDOOv0PHeg2llcYt6KH3bPYd9gejdbKtlBZTcT-sJIZt-8vB1lVJUlIMivD4c_w0CgVgjeTJShkTcl8_Uss65HDcWf2wLO2VSW0Q1yN80Xr_xpaP9BEbbpjY5Wc0YFAjmxXBrNHCNqzUznLiuWwGC5f3pQ%3D%3D)**

Montana is my home. I am not going to let Schumer take it.

I hope you're with me, Peter.

Thank you and God Bless,

clean_body: I want to share something personal with you, Peter. | ** Hey Peter, Let me tell you a little bit about my story and why I am running for Senate in Montana. I was born in Great Falls where my dad taught high school math & my mom taught elementary school. Growing up, we didn't have a lot, but we had everything that mattered: hard work, faith, and a deep sense of what it means to serve others. We moved around a good amount – Dillon, Victor, Helena, and Miles City. Places that are the backbone of our nation. Towns where neighbors show up for each other, and everyone knows everyone. That is the Montana I grew up in. That is the Montana I am fighting to protect. I built my legal career here. I raised my two kids here with my wife Sandra of 32 years. Montana has always been home, and that is never going to change. I am proud to have served this state. As Director of the Department of Revenue, I spearheaded the largest income tax rate cut in Montana history — nearly 40%. As Budget Director, I helped cut wasteful spending, deliver another one of Montana’s largest tax cuts, and put Montana on track to be debt-free. President Trump nominated me twice to be Montana's US Attorney. During my time in that role, we went after drug traffickers and violent criminals who were endangering our communities. We stood up to the cartels. We drove criminal prosecutions to a 20-year high. Montana families deserve to feel safe – and we delivered. Peter, I have never run for office before. But I am running now because the stakes have never been higher. Chuck Schumer has made Montana a top target. He knows that flipping this seat hands him back the Senate so he can stonewall President Trump's agenda. Montana deserves a senator who has lived here, worked here, and will never stop fighting for the people here. That is who I am,and that is why I am asking for your support today. Montana is my home. I am not going to let Schumer take it. I hope you're with me, Peter. Thank you and God Bless, Kurt Alme, Trump-Endorsed Candidate for Montana Senate FOLLOW KURT ALME ON SOCIAL MEDIA** | | Paid for by Alme for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails?
